rule: Unbound with every feature Optilux dropped switched off (docs/shader.md#dropped-features). Kept features are matched to Optilux's measured setting as each one lands (M4-M5); until then they keep their played value.
source: v1 (plans/m3.md M3.P04, P15): played's options with every dropped switch over them, each name and value read in Unbound r5.9.3's shaders/lib/common.glsl and shaders/lang/en_US.lang; `optilux check L0`'s profile check holds every name and value against the studied copy
optionsWhy: what `run` writes to the pack's settings file (record.profile_options): played's options, then each dropped switch, every value as the pack's own text (true or false for an on/off option)
droppedWhy: the switches of docs/shader.md#dropped-features' features, each set off in options, or at its default where no off exists (RAIN_STYLE, WEATHER_TEX_OPACITY) or the feature is inert (IPBR_EMISSIVE_MODE under RP_MODE 0)

droppedNotes.RP_MODE: 0 = Basic, neither IPBR (1) nor custom PBR (2, 3); removes generated normals, coated textures, improved glass, green-screen lime, POM, normal maps and custom emission in one switch; the played settings already use 0. It also gates screen-space block reflections (BLOCK_REFLECT_QUALITY 2 or more needs RP_MODE 1 or more), so matching Optilux's block reflections (M4-M5) moves it
droppedNotes.COLORED_LIGHTING: 0 disables Advanced Color Tracing and its extras (colored light fog, connected glass, portal edges, puddle voxelization); 0 is the default, outside its list
droppedNotes.WEATHER_TEX_OPACITY: no off value: 100, the default, draws rain at a quarter and snow at half of the texture's alpha; any other value raises both to the power 100/value
droppedNotes.RAIN_STYLE: no off value: 1 (Light & Warmer, the default) or 2 (Heavy & Colder, which adds rain fog: lib/atmospherics/fog/mainFog.glsl); played uses 2; ALC measured RAIN_STYLE=1 at -0.020 ms mean
droppedNotes.LIGHTSHAFT_QUALI_DEFINE: 0 = OFF in the Overworld; the End keeps its volumetric pass at the Low count whatever the value, as it draws the End beams, which Optilux keeps
droppedNotes.BORDER_FOG: false, as played; in the Nether it is also Unbound's only distance fog, as the pack undefines its atmospheric and cave fog there, while Optilux keeps Nether fog (docs/handoff.md, open questions)
droppedNotes.IPBR_EMISSIVE_MODE: 1 = IPBR+ Only, the default; inert under RP_MODE 0, as are the other emissive modes

kept.why: Unbound's switch for each feature Optilux keeps; set to match Optilux's setting in the measurement

keys.WATER_REFLECT_QUALITY: water reflection (played 1 = Potato, a faster method than screen-space reflection)
keys.DETAIL_QUALITY: water refraction, on from 3 (High), which also changes other details; played's default 2 draws none
keys.BLOOM_ENABLED: bloom (-1 = off, 1 = on; BLOOM_STRENGTH sets its intensity), as played's ablation row
